app.name: NPKTools
app.tagline: Fertilizer calculator — runs entirely in your browser
salts.title: Salts you have — {0} / {1}
salts.uncovered.note: Nothing ticked above supplies these, so no recipe can reach them.
water.title: Source water
water.osmosis.note: Reverse osmosis, distilled or rain. Nothing is deducted from the target.
water.tests.note: From a drop-test kit. Both optional — each one entered replaces a guess with a measurement.
water.estimate.title: Estimated analysis — not an analysis
water.estimate.infeasible.detail: The hardness entered already accounts for {0} µS/cm, more than the {1} µS/cm the meter read. Check both, and the water type.
water.estimate.off.lead: The estimate is {0}% off the reading.
water.estimate.off.detail: A different water type may fit better.
water.note.analysis: Compare the water EC with your own meter — it is the quickest check that the analysis above was typed in correctly. The alkalinity is inferred from the cation surplus, and is also the acid needed per litre to neutralise it.
water.note.alkalinity: The alkalinity is inferred from the cation surplus, and is also the acid needed per litre to neutralise it.
water.excess.detail: {0}. Fertilizer only adds, so no recipe can bring these down — raise the target or dilute the water.
salt.form.name: Name
salt.form.chelate.body: A chelating agent carries nitrogen that holds the metal rather than feeding the plant, and a formula cannot tell the two apart — entered this way the salt would offer nitrogen it does not have. Describe it by percentages instead, where the agent is named.
salt.form.percentages.note: Percentages by weight, as on the label — but as elements, not oxides. A bag quoting P₂O₅ or K₂O needs converting first: divide by 2.29 for phosphorus, by 1.20 for potassium.
salt.error.StartsWithNumber: A formula cannot start with a number.
salt.error.UnmatchedClosingBracket: A closing bracket has nothing to close.
salt.error.UnknownElement: '{0}' is not an element this calculator knows.
salt.error.noNutrients: The salt carries no nutrients, so no target can use it.
salt.error.percentagesOver100: The percentages add up to {0}, which is more than 100.
salt.error.unknownForm: '{0}' is not a nutrient form this calculator knows.
salt.error.duplicateName: There is already a salt called '{0}'. Pick another name.
acid.title: Acidification
acid.overshoot.lead: This acid overshoots the {0} target on its own.
acid.overshoot.detail: {0} ppm against a target of {1}. Fertilizer only adds, so no recipe can bring it back down.
acid.note: The {0} above is deducted from the target, like the water. Worked for a closed vessel: an open reservoir loses CO₂ and drifts back up, so the dose you settle on will be nearer the full {1} meq/L. Each recipe's EC still counts this water's bicarbonate, which the acid removes, so it reads high once you have acidified — by roughly {2} µS/cm.
notFound.heading: Not Found
notFound.body: Sorry, the content you are looking for does not exist.
error.target.unreadable: That target cannot be read. Use element=ppm pairs separated by spaces, for example N=150 K=210 L=100.
error.shelf.empty: No salts selected. Tick at least one.
error.recipe.unreachable: The selected salts cannot reach this target. Add more, or relax it.
page.title: NPKTools — fertilizer calculator
target.macro.title: Target — macro
target.micro.title: Target — micro
target.asString.note: Element=ppm, separated by spaces. L is the reservoir volume in litres. Paste one from a feed chart, or copy this one out.
target.counterIons.note: Not dosed for — they arrive with other salts — but a target may still name them.
storage.title: Save & transfer
storage.note: Everything stays on this device — there is no server to sync to.
storage.auto.body: This browser remembers your last setup, so closing the tab loses nothing. It cannot reach another browser — that is how browser storage works, not a limit of this app.
storage.link.note: The link carries the whole setup in the address. Copy it into another browser, another device, or a message to someone else. It is also what to bookmark to keep several targets a click apart.
storage.file.note: The file is plain JSON you can keep, edit and re-load. Unlike the other two it survives clearing site data, which makes it the one to use for a recipe you rely on.
storage.msg.saltsIgnored: This link was made with a different version of the salt catalogue, so its salt selection was ignored and everything is ticked. The rest of the link was applied.
storage.msg.copied: Link copied. Paste it into any browser to reopen this setup.
storage.msg.clipboardFailed: Could not reach the clipboard — copy the address bar by hand instead.
storage.msg.notARecipe: That file is not a saved recipe.
storage.msg.forgotten: This browser will no longer remember your setup. The current one is still on screen.
concentrate.title: Concentrate
concentrate.litres: Litres per tank — blank for none
concentrate.note: The whole recipe's salt goes into this much water, so a 100 L recipe in 1 L is 1:100. Calcium is kept away from sulfate and phosphate.
recipe.inReservoir: In the reservoir — salts plus source water
recipe.ecRange.body: This solution is stronger than the reference solutions the EC model was checked against, so treat the figure as an ordering rather than a measurement.
concentrate.summary: Concentrate — 1:{0}, {1} ml of each per litre
concentrate.unknownSolubility: No published figure for {0}, so that ceiling leaves them out and the real one may be lower.
concentrate.warn.SolubilityExceeded.deta: Tank {0} needs {1} g/L of '{2}', which dissolves to {3} g/L at 20 °C. Use a larger concentrate volume, or a more soluble source of that element.
concentrate.warn.TankSaturated.detail: Tank {0} is at {1} of saturation: its salts together need more water than the tank holds, because they compete for the same water. Use a larger concentrate volume.
concentrate.warn.PrecipitationRisk.detai: Tank {0} holds calcium together with sulfate or phosphate ({1}). These precipitate at concentrate strength even though they stay dissolved at working strength. Move one group to the other tank.
concentrate.warn.TankInferred.detail: '{0}' has no tank of its own, so tank {1} was chosen from what it contains.
recipes.empty.noRun: Enter a target and the calculator will work out the recipes.
recipes.empty.none: No recipe for this combination. See the message on the left.
recipes.note: Every one of these hits the target. They differ in which salts they use, so pick by what you would rather spend, or by which figures below you prefer.
